base_member_text: quiver @L47 indexes the 1-D vectors x,y with 2-D subscripts (1:sk:end,1:sk:end) — for row/column vectors the second subscript degenerates, so the x/y arguments become subsampled vectors while u,v are subsampled 2-D arrays; relies on quiver's vector-input broadcasting

pcolor(x,y,ht) @L41 plots Hsig but the commented ylabel text @L63-L64 says '\eta (m)' and the commented print name @L68 references the inlet_shoal case — copied from another script; cell variable 'min' @L19 shadows the MATLAB builtin and its '200' label is unused (title commented @L45)
caxis([-0. 1]) @L43 uses negative zero as lower bound; dx/dy hardcoded 2.0 must match the case's input.txt

audit_member_text: Grid dimensions are taken only from eta_00001 at lines 4-10, but u, v, ht, and mask for each fnum are loaded at lines 30-33 and indexed together at lines 35-47 without shape checks. Any output whose dimensions differ from eta_00001 or from its peer fields causes logical-index or plotting dimension failures.
The only image-export command is commented out at line 68, so despite configuring paper size at line 23 the script produces no persistent output file.

Sponge/wavemaker polygons and labels are hard-coded in physical coordinates at lines 12-15 and 50-55; their positions are not derived from input metadata and can lie outside or mislabel grids whose extent differs from this case.
The variable min is defined at line 19 but its sole title use is commented at line 45; nfile can be lengthened independently of min without any active time annotation or validation.
